Next year's iPhone Pro model is expected to feature a brand-new all-glass design, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of the iPhone. Today, a new leak has detailed Apple's progress on this innovative model.

Here is the latest news on Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design

With Apple's first foldable model — the innovative iPhone Ultra — just weeks away from launch, next year will bring another distinctive new iPhone design.

Rumours suggest Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro model. According to reports, the new model will feature a larger screen with a quad-curved display that extends to the edges of the body, creating a visually near-bezel-less effect.

Weibo tipster Fixed Focus Digital posted today, updating on Apple's progress in achieving this distinctive look.

He noted that the company is using the same glass assembly process as the iPhone Air, but with modifications to incorporate more rounded materials.

The post also mentioned that two aspects have been improved:

  • Thermal performance
  • Body thickness

It is still too early to judge Apple's target body thickness and design materials. However, current signs indicate that this new model will draw inspiration from the iPhone Air and Ultra, but will not prioritise slimness to the same extent.

Based on these latest updates, it seems we may see some of the design innovations from the iPhone Air and Ultra in the new model, while still delivering the performance and battery life that Pro users expect.

Pro users do not want to sacrifice performance for a slim body. But if Apple can deliver a comparable experience in a slightly thinner model with a unique all-glass aesthetic, it would be extremely appealing.

How interested are you in next year's rumoured iPhone Pro 20 model? Let us know in the comments.
